questions.prompt: Which of these novels did Jane Austen write?
questions.fact: Austen's books came out without her name. The first was credited only to 'A Lady'.

questions.prompt: Which of these characters are in The Simpsons?
questions.fact: Stewie is from Family Guy, Kenny from South Park, and Hank Hill from King of the Hill.

questions.prompt: How many ships sailed in the Spanish Armada?
questions.fact: About 130 in 1588. Storms off Scotland and Ireland sank more of them than the English navy did.

questions.prompt: How many years of marriage does a golden wedding anniversary mark?
questions.fact: Fifty. A silver anniversary is 25 years and a diamond one is 60.

questions.prompt: Which country hosted the first modern Olympics, in 1896?
questions.hint: It was chosen to honour the ancient Games.
questions.fact: The 1896 Games in Athens had 241 athletes, all of them men.

questions.prompt: Which bird is the fastest in a dive?
questions.hint: It hunts other birds by dropping on them from above.
questions.fact: A peregrine falcon can pass 300 km/h in a dive, faster than any other animal.
